focused_question_template: Static analysis found an indexed write `{array}[{index_expr}]` into a fixed-size array of {elem_count} element(s), with NO established guarantee that `{index_expr}` stays < {elem_count} on every path reaching this write. Based ONLY on the supplied code, is `{index_expr}` guaranteed to stay within [0, {elem_count}-1] on all paths to this write (SAFE), can it reach or exceed {elem_count} (UNSAFE), or is the evidence insufficient (UNKNOWN)? Do not assume a caller validates the index; answer only about this write.
established_meaning: modeled candidate shape only (an indexed store into a fixed-capacity array whose index bound is not statically established; NOT a confirmed OOB write): triggerability, reachability, and caller-side validation are out of scope for this property

attestation_binding.property_id_construction: property_id = 'oob-index:{fingerprint}.index_within_capacity'. The fingerprint is sha256 over a canonical record of {analyzer_version, repo_rev, file, candidate_class, subclass, array, elem_count, index_expr, line}. A trusted attestation is keyed by this fingerprint, so it binds to the EXACT reviewed candidate.
attestation_binding.invalidation: changing the code (index_expr/line), capacity (elem_count), array, file, candidate class, repository revision, or the analyzer/config version re-fingerprints the candidate; an attestation minted for the old fingerprint no longer matches and cannot suppress.
attestation_binding.duplicate_and_mismatch: two candidates sharing a fingerprint are AMBIGUOUS and are never suppressed; a trusted attestation whose optional declared_facts do not match the candidate is REJECTED (packet emitted).

identity_derivation_R04.content_identity: full SHA-256 of the ACTUAL scanned file bytes (working tree; covers uncommitted/untracked/dirty-worktree). Supplied by the trusted scanner from the exact bytes fed to the frontend. A commit id is NOT used. If a candidate's file content is unverified, the adjudicator FAILS CLOSED (never suppresses).
identity_derivation_R04.analyzer_identity: full SHA-256 over analyzer component files on disk (producer + adjudicator + config + frontend normalizer/exporter). No manually maintained version string.
identity_derivation_R04.hash: the FULL 256-bit sha-256 (64 hex) is used for the trust decision; no prefix truncation.
identity_derivation_R04.serialization: explicit canonical JSON: fixed field names + types, sort_keys, compact separators, ascii.
identity_derivation_R04.bound_context: analyzer_identity, content_sha256, file, candidate_class, subclass, array, elem_count, index_expr, function, line, function_span.
identity_derivation_R04.no_caller_selection: analyzer/content/repo identity are derived by trusted runtime only; there is no CLI/packet/hint field to set them, and any such key inside a hint is stripped.
identity_derivation_R04.recompute_not_echo: suppression is decided on a fingerprint RECOMPUTED from producer facts + trusted digests; a fingerprint echoed in a packet/hint is never trusted.

hint_acceptance.trust_establishing_path: the loader (adjudicate_oob.load_channels) assigns trust by WHICH channel/flag loaded the hint: --oob-trusted-attestations => CURATED_ATTESTATION_CHANNEL (may suppress); --oob-hints => UNTRUSTED_CHANNEL (advisory only). Any source/trust key inside a hint is stripped and OVERWRITTEN to the channel identity.
hint_acceptance.rule: A SAFE hint SUPPRESSES a deterministic candidate ONLY when it arrives through the trusted curated-attestation channel AND confidence==HIGH AND proposed_value==SAFE. Hints from the advisory (untrusted) channel — including a model-generated answer that falsely declares source=CURATED_ATTESTATION — are ADVISORY ONLY and MUST NOT erase the candidate; the review packet is still emitted.

residual_vulnerability_questions: reachability of the enclosing function with an attacker-influenced index
caller-side validation of the index or of an upstream length/count
whether the index can actually exceed the capacity under any input
interprocedural bounds established outside this translation unit
